- **Retention runs at run start and fails safe.** The newest 5 logs are left untouched; the older ones are deleted oldest-first until their combined size is back under a 500 MB budget. A log whose lock names a live PID — or a lock retention cannot read, or that does not name a PID — is never pruned: it keeps what it cannot show is finished. A PID is the WHOLE lock content as digits, so a lock reading `123garbage` is not one (a prefix parse would read it as 123 and prune the log on a number the lock never named); unparsable means KEEP. (`test/shell/run-log.test.ts`)
